body.segment: The ability of nano-hydroxyapatite (nHA) particles developed in-house to act as non-viral delivery vectors is assessed.
These nHA particles are combined with collagen to yield bioactive, biodegradable collagen nano-hydroxyapatite (coll-nHA) scaffolds.
Their ability to act as gene-activated matrices for BMP2 delivery is demonstrated with successful transfection of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) resulting in high calcium production.
